svg.title: Relational model, sheet 2
svg.text: Sheet 2 of 2 - Accounts, saved analysis and authentication
Mapping from Chen sheet 2 | Authentication support tables added from the current implementation
Owner may be NULL for preserved legacy cases.
query_id is NOT unique; run_id identifies a run.
top_k: 1-100. Each run belongs to one case.
UNIQUE run_id: zero or one evaluation per run.
Stores token hashes, never raw session tokens.
No foreign key to users or sessions.
Cases have zero or more runs. Each saved result references one run and one patent.
An evaluation is optional. Multiple recommendations may belong to one run.
PK = primary key (underlined) FK = foreign key UQ = unique constraint ? = NULL permitted
All PK-marked fields in a table form ONE key. Arrows point from FK fields to referenced PKs; joined branches share that PK target.
Defaults and secondary indexes omitted. [ref] repeats an existing table.
